xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana:
Value of Transaction Rs.0.0006 Crores.
Notes to Related party transactions for the half year ended 30th September, 2025: 1. Loans given and returned within the reporting period have not been reported. 2. Opening and closing balance are not given where there was no transaction of Investment during the half year ended September 30, 2025. 3. Foreign Currency transactions are converted at an average rate of exchange during the period. Foreign currency opening and closing balances are convered at a rate of exchanges as at the respective closing date. 4. The interest rates of loan are as applicable as on September 30, 2025. 5.Approval granted by the Audit Committee in foreign currency are shown in INR basis the exchange rate as on September 30, 2025. 6.Transactions with the employees of the Parent Company who are appointed as Directors / KMPs on it's subsidiary companies have not been disclosed considering that such transactions are in accordance with their terms of employment. 7. Post employment benefits are actuarially determined on overall basis and hence not separately provided.
